statement: Start a family from a category-specific template that fixes host type, category and default parameters.
superiority: Make templates open and editable, and allow hosted behaviour to change after creation.

acceptance.sketch: A door template yields a host-based family that cuts wall openings.

statement: Assign the family a category and set its behaviour flags, such as work plane-based, always vertical, cut with voids when loaded, cuttable in views and shared when nested.
superiority: Show the effects of each flag in plain language with a preview.

acceptance.sketch: Always-vertical flag keeps a slanted host instance vertical.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Room calculation point is not a flag in this dialog; it is a separate instance setting enabled in the family's Properties (page GUID-7CA9496D). Remaining flags confirmed.

statement: Create a solid extrusion from a sketched profile on a work plane with start and end depth.
superiority: Use direct push-pull editing of faces in addition to sketch mode.

acceptance.sketch: Extrusion volume equals profile area times depth.

statement: Create a blend between a base and top profile at a depth.
superiority: Allow multi-profile loft with live edits.

acceptance.sketch: Blend of two rectangles has a volume per the prismatoid formula.

statement: Create a solid by revolving a profile around an axis through a given angle.
superiority: Show revolve axis handles live.

acceptance.sketch: Revolved volume equals Pappus theorem value.

statement: Create a solid by sweeping a profile along a path.
superiority: Profile and path both editable in place.

acceptance.sketch: Sweep volume equals profile area times path length for a straight path.

statement: Create a swept blend with two profiles along a path.
superiority: Handle twist in a controllable way.

acceptance.sketch: Volume matches numeric integration.

statement: Cut voids using extrusion, blend, revolve, sweep or swept blend void forms inside a family.

source.ref: About Creating Solid and Void Geometry

superiority: Preview voids as ghost geometry and show the removed volume live.

acceptance.sketch: Void removes exactly the intersection volume from the solid.

statement: Draw 3D model lines or view-specific symbolic lines for 2D representation.

acceptance.sketch: Symbolic line appears only in selected orientations.

statement: Add masking regions (closed sketches that hide whatever lies behind the family, with visibility and detail-level controls) and, in annotation or detail families, filled regions with a fill pattern.

acceptance.sketch: Masking region hides geometry beneath it in the chosen view only.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Masking regions obscure model and detail elements behind the family; filled regions are documented for annotation/detail families, not as a general 2D appearance tool for plan and elevation.

statement: Create an opening shape in the host element for hosted families such as doors and windows.

acceptance.sketch: The cut in a host wall equals the sketched opening area.

statement: Set reference planes as strong, weak, left/right, front/back, top/bottom or not a reference.

statement: Mark a reference plane as defining the family origin so the insertion point is controlled.

statement: Create family types and edit their parameter values in a table.

statement: Turn a multi-segment permanent dimension into an equality constraint (EQ) so the intermediate references stay evenly spaced between the outer two as the family is resized.

statement: Lock a face or edge to a reference plane so it follows when the reference moves.

acceptance.sketch: Face coincident with plane within 1e-6 after align.
